indicator_definition: Final energy consumption measures the total energy consumed by end users (industry, transport, households, services and agriculture), excluding energy used by the energy sector itself. It is expressed in million tonnes of oil equivalent (Mtoe) and serves as a key indicator of energy demand. Data are compiled by Eurostat from national energy balances.
rationale: Reducing final energy consumption is essential for meeting climate targets and improving energy security. Energy efficiency improvements allow economic growth to decouple from energy use. Progress means a sustained reduction in final energy consumption while maintaining economic activity.
methodology_characteristics: Data are compiled by Eurostat from national energy balances reported under EU energy statistics regulations. Final energy consumption excludes non-energy use and energy consumed by the energy transformation sector. Data are reported annually in tonnes of oil equivalent.
